name: Oven-Roasted Broccoli
directions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Cut the broccoli into florets and toss with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet. Roast 18-22 minutes, until tender and browned at the edges. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the top and serve.
